title: Harness capabilities
description: What probe() reports about a runtime adapter. The engine validates a playbook against this before a run starts, so unsupported settings fail at load time rather than mid-run.

sessionAssignment.description: preassign: the engine chooses the session id up front (claude --session-id), so a crashed invocation is reconcilable by id. discover: the id only exists after the first invocation returns, so recovery needs invocation-marker evidence and may end in recovery-required.

resume.description: Can continue an existing session across separate process invocations.

structuredOutput.description: Can be constrained to a JSON schema. When false the engine falls back to fenced-JSON extraction plus protocol repair.

instructions.description: Accepts a separate system/instruction channel distinct from the turn prompt.

capabilities.description: Declared by the adapter. Verified against the runtime only at the deeper probe levels.

diagnostics.description: Free-form; surfaced in the GUI when available is false.

installation.description: Depth 1. An installed binary proves ONLY that a binary exists.

authentication.description: Depth 2. Whether the runtime has usable credentials. 'unknown' is the honest answer when it was not probed — never assume ok.

modelAccess.description: Depth 3, keyed by wire model id. Authentication succeeding does not imply access to a particular model.

depth.description: How deep this probe went. A shallower probe leaves the deeper fields 'unknown'.

connection.description: Echoes the connection the probe was asked about, so a caller can confirm the result belongs to THAT provider configuration. Required: without it, a result cannot be tied to the request, and one provider's authentication could vouch for another's.

applied.description: What was actually applied to the launched process, as opposed to what was requested.

account.description: Which person's login this probe ran under, echoed back so one account cannot vouch for another.

usage.description: What the deep probe spent. A probe at depth 2 or 3 costs a call, so its spend must be visible to whatever is budgeting.

invocations.description: How many calls the probe ATTEMPTED, including failures — a failed call may still have cost something.
